historical_results.interpretation: Original records checked in local archive. These are not freshly rerun results and are not bundled again as generated tables.

dependencies: C25, Park III, Lee, Zhang and several later regressions reuse G11/R19 or related SDSS observations; our audit identifies 33 shared G11/R19 SN IDs.
W26 and C26 apply different residual/error/cut choices to overlapping Pantheon+ events.
TITAN population estimates and its final luminosity-bias inference are different evidence components; the latter uses the disputed residual-age slope.
ZTF observations differ from older compilations but their trained SED and calibration share ancestry with other surveys.
Corrected-template cosmological applications condition on the age prescription rather than independently establish it.
publication_policy: Only original synthesis, prospective plan and compact provenance are tracked. Downloadable source pages/PDFs stay under ignored data/literature; historical source artifacts remain in the original archive.
